notes: Counties charge a yearly personal property tax on the vehicle, which is not included.
Any separate electric or hybrid vehicle fee is not listed on the Department's fee page and is not included.
Safety inspection and emissions testing fees, lien recording and license office fees are not included.

content.intro: {state} charges {stateRate} state sales tax plus local tax on the price less any trade-in. The yearly registration fee depends on the taxable horsepower on your title.

howItWorks.text: The state rate and the local rate are both charged on the purchase price less any trade-in allowance.
Local rates depend on where you live. The Department of Revenue publishes a chart of motor vehicle local rates.
Registration is priced by taxable horsepower, which is printed on your title. Electric vehicles are in the lowest bracket. A processing fee is added to each registration.

faq.q: Where do I find my vehicle's taxable horsepower?
faq.text: It is recorded on your title or on your application for a {state} title and registration. It is not the engine's rated horsepower.

faq.q: Does a trade-in lower the tax in {state}?
faq.text: Yes. Both the state and local sales tax are charged on the price less the trade-in allowance.
